headline: Dead Lands And Lykos Isle Shift As Fisherman's Row Front Pauses
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline volatility has centered sharply on the Dead Lands and Lykos Isle, both logging fresh outpost transitions within the past two hours. In the Dead Lands, fierce combat surrounding The Salt March and Callahan's Boot drove nearly twenty-four hundred casualties in the two-hour span, with Warden losses accelerating rapidly. Meanwhile, the island fighting in Lykos Isle flared up with two strategic base turnovers. In contrast, the rapid base exchanges in Fisherman's Row have finally stalled over the last two hours, though steady infantry clashes persist. Massive attritional grinding continues unabated in Weathered Expanse, which yielded another two thousand casualties across static defenses. Heavy bloodletting also endures in King's Cage, where Warden casualty rates surged as Colonial positions held firm. Elsewhere along the front, including Linn of Mercy, Farranac Coast, and Loch Mor, skirmishes continue at a measured tempo with no fresh changes in ownership.
